home.title: React Template
home.subtitle: A production-ready starting point for React apps: typed routing, server state, i18n and Docker deploy — wired up and ready to build on.

about.title: About this template
about.intro: A minimal but complete skeleton for production React applications. Everything you usually wire up by hand in the first week of a project is already in place and organized by Feature-Sliced Design.

includes.routing: Type-safe, code-split routing with TanStack Router
includes.query: Server state with TanStack Query and a tuned QueryClient
includes.ui: Tailwind CSS 4 and shadcn/ui primitives with dark mode
includes.i18n: i18next with automatic language detection (ru / en / uz)
includes.env: Runtime environment variables — one image for every environment
includes.quality: Strict TypeScript, ESLint, Prettier and Vitest

layers.app: Application wiring: entry point, providers, router
layers.pages: Route screens composed from the layers below
layers.widgets: Self-contained page blocks, e.g. the header
layers.features: User interactions: theme and language switching
layers.entities: Business data and its API, e.g. health
layers.shared: UI kit, API client, constants, utilities
